Inclusion criteria for patients were (1) a diagnosis of schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder verified using the SCID interview ( ); (2) a duration of psychotic symptoms less than eight years; (3) clinically stabilized on antipsychotic medication (assessed via SCID and available medical history in consensus conferences); (4) age 18–45 years; (5) current IQ greater than 80 as assessed using the WASI-II ( ); and (6) the ability to read (sixth grade level or higher) and speak fluent English.
